title: Towards Last-layer Retraining for Group Robustness with Fewer Annotations
benchmark_measurement: Bias against religious identity categories (Christian, Muslim) in toxicity classification, where the presence of a religious identity term is a spurious feature.
findings: The paper proposes methods (class-balanced last-layer retraining and selective last-layer finetuning) that improve worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments dataset. This indicates the methods can reduce a model's reliance on spurious correlations tied to religious identities (like 'Christian' or 'Muslim') when classifying text toxicity, even with few or no group annotations.
references: Martin Arjovsky, Léon Bottou, Ishaan Gulrajani, and David Lopez-Paz. Invariant risk minimization. arXiv preprint 1907.02893, 2019. Cited on page 3.
